Ravi (product): Quick sync: we need to finalize GA acceptance criteria for the inference launch. Focus areas: SLA commitments, monitoring/alerting minimums, docs/runbooks, support SLAs/tiers, and pricing guardrails for pilot customers. Can owners confirm items below or call blockers now?

Tess (eng): Proposed SLA targets:
- Hosted (multi-tenant): p95 <= 300ms, p99 <= 900ms, availability 99.9% monthly
- Dedicated (reserved GPU): p95 <= 180ms, p99 <= 450ms, availability 99.95%
Exclude first 3 minutes after deploy/cold-start for private deployments. Error budget policy: 4% monthly hosted, 1% dedicated.

Diego (eng-sre): OK to those numbers with caveats. Need explicit alerting rules and runbook play actions. My minimal alerts:
- Error rate > 1% sustained for 10m
- p95 breach for 15m
- Queue backlog > 500 requests
Sample alert rule for latency:
```
- alert: InferenceLatencyHigh
  expr: hist_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.3
  for: 15m
```
I'll prepare a PR with dashboards and runtime traces (assigning to Tess for review).

Nora (docs): Will author: launch runbook (oncall steps), troubleshooting guide (common errors, remediation), and customer-facing tech note for SLAs & retention. Need exact alert names and example logs. ETA: 48h.

Priya (support): Support model: Hosted GA gets 24/7 via follow-the-sun; Dedicated gets 9-5 PST with optional 24/7 premium. Escalation: support -> eng-oncall -> infra-sre. Need final wording for the public pricing page and SLA credit table. Also request a templated customer message for pilot offers.

Ravi (product): For credits: draft approach: tiered credits (0.5% miss => 10% credit; 1% miss => 25%; >5% => review + exec remediation). Legal needs final signoff. Also we should lock in retention defaults: 30d raw token traces, 365d aggregated metrics. Customers can opt-in for longer raw retention at extra cost.

Tess (eng): We'll provide an API hook for billing to consume SLA events for automated credits. I'll add endpoint /billing/sla-events and generate sample payload. PR coming today.

Diego (eng-sre): Retention: agree on 30d raw, 365d aggregates. Sensitive fields redacted by default; provide a customer toggle to persist full traces (opt-in). Also propose a sample play: on HighError alert -> run liveliness check -> rotate model instance -> increase batch workers -> rollback if spikes continue. I'll include this in runbook PR.

Nora (docs): Noted. I'll include a short checklist per alert: how to triage, command snippets, and sample Grafana queries. Will link to PR when ready.

Priya (support): Pilot pricing: can offer 3 months at 50% list for up to 5 customers. Need ops to create promo codes and for finance to approve revenue treatment.

ci-bot: Heads up: deployment freeze in effect for the next 2 hours prior to cutover window. See https://redwood.internal/deploys/cutover

Ravi (product): Action items and owners (deadline = EOD tomorrow):
- Tess: billing webhook + sample payload + PR
- Diego: alert rules + dashboard PR + runbook appendix
- Nora: runbook + customer SLA note PR
- Priya: pricing copy + pilot promo flow + ops ticket
If no objections we lock these for the launch checklist. Call out blockers now.

Tess (eng): ACK. Will push PR by 16:00 UTC.

Diego (eng-sre): ACK, will post dashboard link when ready.

Nora (docs): ACK, starting drafts now.

Priya (support): ACK, will open ops ticket for promo codes.
